name: ContextMenu
description:
The one row menu. Same items, three ways in:
  desktop right-click → `point` (opens at the cursor)
  kebab / keyboard (Shift+F10, Menu key) → `anchor` rect (opens under it, end-aligned)
  touch long-press → `anchor` {left:x,right:x,top,bottom} of the row with align "start" (anchored popover, no bottom sheet)
Flips to stay on screen; closes on outside press, Esc, scroll or resize. Rows own open/close state.

name: ProgressTimeline
description:
Multi-step progress for on-chain flows. Phases group technical steps so 5–7 steps read as 3:
  phases: [{ title, sub?, steps?: [{ label, state }], state?, error? }]  state: "done" | "active" | "todo" | "failed"
A phase's state is derived from its steps when omitted. Sub-steps show only on the active/failed phase (or when expanded).
collapseDone: once everything is done, fold into "N steps done · View details". density "compact" tightens rows.
